<div class="card-body">
'''Rogue 1''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ローグ1</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ルークが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。ホスの位置に対してのみリアクションとして移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Rogue-1-PSA-74248139.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">またの名をローグ・リーダー。ホスの戦いでスノースピーダー隊を率いた。密閉型。スカイウォーカー中佐が操縦し、ダク・ロルタが尾砲の砲手を務めた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rogue 1.

'''Card text:'''
May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Luke is piloting. May move as a react only to a Hoth location.

'''Lore:'''
Also known as Rogue Leader. Led the snowspeeder unit at the Battle of Hoth. Enclosed. Commander Skywalker piloted, with Dack Ralter as tail gunner.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore says またの名を (also known as) rather than “Designated”, and 中佐 rather than Commander.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rogue 1]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
